name: com.lechuck.sdk
description: Unity WebGL bridge for the Minijuegos.com / Miniplay.com LeChuck JS SDK. Auth detection, score, stats, achievements and session flush, fully configurable via a settings asset. No keys or IDs bundled: bring your own game ID from the Minijuegos developer panel.

samples.description: Minimal example: init, submit score on game over, unlock achievements, flush before restart.
